plan.idea: 先确认风格划分，每种风格的样本训练模型在该风格上应优于全样本模型；先验证当前DFT。
plan.selection_rule: Compare own-style specialist vs all-style v5 on the same dates; net_ann and net_sharpe both positive deltas supports the operational claim in this historical selection window. Report each style separately, seed wins, cross-style matrix and RankIC; no automatic promotion.
plan.known_native_scope_gap: One parent native variant plus per-fit jobs; supplemental ledger tracks three internal science candidates and receipts. Native result uses predesignated D actual five sessions; report covers all three.

train-data/dft-specialists-20261108-v1.hypothesis: 原DFT风格内样本训练的专属选股模型，在对应风格的Top3×H5净年化与夏普优于使用全部既定训练样本的v5模型。

reflections.observations: 1/3种风格的对应专属模型同时提高净年化与夏普；本窗口未全面支持三类均应胜出的命题。
reflections.interpretation: 原DFT、同一v5样本基底、只改训练风格日期。官方五种子合成信号与逐种子成对结果分开，跨风格矩阵检验针对性。历史选型窗口参与全窗早停，F/T时期有限；不是独立样本外。仅训练样本过滤；未检验各风格自身窗口早停，不能把本轮结论等同后者。
